---
applyTo: "README.md"
description: "Use when editing or rewriting README.md. Enforces section order, content rules, and brevity."
---

# Structure

Sections must appear in this exact order. Optional sections may be omitted entirely.

```
# {Project Name}

## Installation

## Quickstart

(optional) ## Key Features

(optional) ## Documentation

```

# Section Contents
- **Project Name**: One paragraph covering what the project is and why it exists.
- **Documentation**: Table of contents linking to docs.
